name: Bonfire
purpose: Public-owner solicitation portal. Carries municipal/county RFPs, addenda, Q&A responses and bid tabulations.

auth.notes: Vendor portal account per issuing agency.

known_limits: Emits notice types that are NOT invitations - 'Preliminary Bid Tabulation', award notices, Q&A postings. These must be classified, not imported as leads.
Bid tabulations are a competitive-intelligence goldmine and should be routed to the learning loop, not the pipeline.
owner_action_required: Bid tabulations from Bonfire are the single best source of competitor pricing - worth a dedicated parser.
